prompt: I need a landing page for a meal-prep delivery service for people who lift weights. It's called Forge.

assertions.text: Uses a restrained neutral palette with at most one accent and no purple/blue or pink/orange gradient
No centered hero with two buttons on a gradient
Copy is specific (Forge, meal-prep, lifting/weight training) rather than generic AI filler
Uses at most two typefaces, with a distinctive display face
At least one section breaks the container or uses an asymmetric layout
No generic words such as seamlessly, innovative, cutting-edge, empower, unlock, leverage, or next-generation
